steps: Rinse the rice, then combine with water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook the rice for 18 minutes until water is absorbed.
While rice cooks, dice the zucchini into 1 cm pieces and slice the cooked carrot into thin rounds.
Remove any pin bones from the salmon and cut it into 3 cm chunks.
Heat olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat and add finely minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the salmon chunks and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, turning once, until no pink remains.
Add the zucchini, cooked carrot, lemon juice, and coconut aminos; stir and cook for 3 minutes until zucchini softens.
Fluff the rice and divide into bowls, then spoon the salmon and vegetable mixture on top.
Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 2 days.

recette.name: Lentil and Sweet Potato Patties
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and cube the sweet potato, then steam or boil for 10 minutes until completely soft.
Drain the sweet potato and mash it in a large bowl until smooth.
Add the cooked lentils, finely minced garlic, cumin, and turmeric to the bowl.
Add the egg and oat flour, then stir firmly until a thick, scoopable mixture forms.
Scoop 16 equal portions onto the lined baking sheet and flatten each to about 1.5 cm thick.
Brush the tops with olive oil and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until golden and firm to the touch.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving. Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.

recette.name: Banana & Chickpea Flour Pancakes
steps: Mash the banana very smoothly in a large bowl until no lumps remain.
Add the fortified soy beverage and canola oil to the bowl and whisk together.
Add the chickpea flour, cinnamon, and baking soda and whisk until a smooth, thick batter forms.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and brush lightly with a little extra canola oil.
Drop 2-tablespoon portions of batter into the skillet to form small rounds, fitting 3 to 4 at a time.
Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until small bubbles appear on the surface and the edges look set.
Flip each pancake and cook for a further 2 minutes, until cooked through with no raw batter visible.

Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining batter. Serve warm, cut into strips for easy baby grasping. Store cooled pancakes in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 1 month.

recette.name: Sweet Potato & Oat Bites
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Peel and dice the sweet potato into small cubes, then steam for 10 minutes until very tender.
Mash the cooked sweet potato thoroughly in a large bowl until completely smooth.
Add the mashed banana and canola oil to the bowl and stir until combined.
Add the rolled oats, oat flour, cinnamon, and baking powder to the bowl and mix until a soft dough forms.
Scoop tablespoon-sized portions of dough and roll into 18 balls, then place on the prepared baking sheet.
Press each ball gently into a small round disc about 1.5 cm thick.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until lightly golden on the edges and firm to the touch.
Cool on the sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days in the fridge or freeze for up to 1 month.

recette.name: Ground Turkey and Zucchini Rice Skillet
steps: Cook rice according to package directions using unsalted chicken broth instead of water.
Grate zucchini on a box grater; slice carrot (cooked) into thin half-moons.
Mince garlic finely; set aside with vegetables.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, 180 °C (350 °F).
Add ground turkey; cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains.
Add garlic, zucchini, and carrot (cooked); cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and spinach; cook 2 minutes until spinach wilts completely.
Add cooked rice to the skillet; stir gently to combine everything evenly.
Yield: 4 family portions. Store refrigerated up to 3 days; freeze up to 2 months.

recette.name: Lentil and Sweet Potato Bowl
steps: Peel and dice sweet potato into 2 cm cubes; slice carrot (cooked) into rounds.
Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, 180 °C (350 °F).
Add cumin and turmeric to the pan; stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add sweet potato and carrot (cooked) to the pan; stir to coat with spices.
Pour in unsalted vegetable broth; bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
Cook for 15 minutes, until sweet potato is completely tender when pierced.
Add cooked lentils; stir and simmer for 5 more minutes until heated through.
Remove from heat; drizzle with lemon juice and mash to desired texture.
Yield: 4 family portions. Refrigerate for up to 3 days; freeze for up to 2 months.
